parameters.active_filter: IMM-EKF (Singer CV / CA 6D / coordinated-turn) + JPDA bearing–range
parameters.truth_layout: 1000 targets uniform range 50–392 km; speed mix 10% Mach2 … 20% 250kn; CV/CA/CT manoeuvres up to 9 g

sensor_fusion.description: Why fused tracks are A-only vs A+B. B max range is ~179 km; A is 400 km. Mask bit set only when JPDA meas mass >= 0.35 on that radar pass.

jpda_a_meas_p_histogram.description: Distribution of JPDA measurement association mass meas_p on radar-A passes (one sample per active track per A scan with detections). Operational contact threshold remains 0.35.

track_quality.description: Following error vs ground truth on TrackToTruth-associated samples. identity_switch = filter path jumped to a different truth; filter_handoff = new filter id on same truth.

coast_relock_imm.description: IMM sub-model (CV/CA/CT) at coast-then-relock handoffs vs all filter-path samples. Crosstab rows = dominant IMM, cols = prior-truth motion mode.

coast_relock_study.description: CoastThenRelock = at new TrackToTruth segment start, filter is outside the prior truth BR gate but inside the new truth gate.

switch_diagnosis.description: Why TrackToTruth reports identity switches. Often label flicker in dense scenes, not filter physically jumping.

radar_a_coast_relock.description: Coast-relock handoffs vs radar-A 6 s rotation: gaps since last A JPDA update on the filter track and since A last plotted the prior truth.

radar_a.note: Active dual-radar TrackToTruth uses A bearing–range gate and this revisit window.

radar_b.note: Reference only until B-specific TrackToTruth gate is wired.

tracks.description: total_unique_tracks = one fused-network row per true plot. fused_lifecycle_tracks = long-coast JPDA+EKF segments (sequential per-sensor).
